institution: IIIT Ranchi (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Ranchi)
data_source: Careers360 student reviews and Q&A (aggregated public review data)

key_positive_themes.notes: Top-rated category (4.7/5); average package reported at 15.95 LPA in 2023 (per institute brochure/LinkedIn), highest package 83 LPA on-campus; core companies like Nvidia, Logic Fruit, and Synopsys have visited campus.

Also rated 4.7/5; faculty are highly qualified PhD holders described as supportive and friendly; curriculum is updated and industry/future-ready, including optional specialization tracks like Machine Learning and Antenna Design.
Good hostel facilities with individual bed, table, and cupboard per student; decent daily food menu including eggs every morning and non-veg dishes three days a week; fully furnished labs.
Rated 4.4/5 — fees considered justified given the institute's national importance status and strong career outcomes.
Good connectivity (6 km from airport, 5 km from railway station); pleasant Ranchi weather; active campus life with many organized events, clubs, and societies.

key_negative_themes.notes: IIIT Ranchi currently operates from rented campuses (locations including Jupmi and Namkum in Ranchi, with earlier years reportedly at NIT Jamshedpur); permanent campus construction targeted for completion around 2024.
While hostel facilities are praised, mess food quality is repeatedly noted as not being as good as other aspects of student life.

Some reviews cite more modest figures (average package 8-9 LPA, on-campus highest 16 LPA, off-campus highest 35 LPA) for certain batches/branches, contrasting with the higher headline figures (15.95 LPA average, 83 LPA highest) reported elsewhere — suggesting variance across years or branches.

sample_reviews_analyzed.review_snippet: Honest review of IIIT Ranchi — classes in rented campus, hostel very good but mess food not that good, average package 15.95 LPA, highest 83 LPA in 2023
IIIT Ranchi running in two rented campuses (Jupmi and Namkum) due to ongoing permanent campus construction, but both have best facilities for students
Average package of placements between 8 to 9 lakhs, highest 16 lakhs on-campus, 35 lakhs off-campus; core companies like Nvidia, Logic Fruit, Synopsys visited
Giving review to my college — all necessary infrastructure, very good and advanced equipment for BTech, MTech, and PhD students
IIIT Ranchi is not in Ranchi, running at NIT Jamshedpur, building under construction, will take 4-5 years — students enjoy all NIT facilities and faculties

conclusion: Sentiment toward IIIT Ranchi is strongly positive, standing out for excellent academics and placement outcomes — among the best of any IIIT reviewed, with packages reaching as high as 83 LPA and core-sector recruiters like Nvidia and Synopsys visiting campus. The primary drawback remains the lack of a permanent campus, with the institute currently operating from rented facilities, alongside mess food quality as a recurring minor complaint.
disclaimer: This analysis is based on a sample of publicly available student reviews and Q&A threads (Careers360) as of the search date and is illustrative, not a scientifically exhaustive sentiment study.
